newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady, light - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady, light - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady, compared with Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand moderate. Seller interest moderate and offerings were current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 70.50-71.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1175 lbs 71.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Wednesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1225 lbs few 113.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs few 104.00-105.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 113.00 few 114.00.

For the week - 34,000 Wk ago - 31,200 Yr ago - 30,600 Steers and heifers - Live basis - 1.00 lower. Carcass basis - mostly 1.00 lower. Confirmed- 1,700 Week Ago - 16,400 Year Ago - 5,200 Wk to Date- 31,700 Week Ago - 31,200 Year Ago- 30,600
